summary_markdown: The discussion focused on potential additions to the inventory data set. Specifically, [p1] questioned whether two parameters—`visibility_factor_2` and `digital attraction multiplier`—should be included in the inventory metrics. [me] agreed that these two parameters should be added since they are available. Regarding area calculation, while physical area (площадь) is currently missing, both parties agreed that it could be calculated by multiplying height by width, as this is standard practice when clients provide dimensions.
decisions: Add `visibility_factor_2` and `digital attraction multiplier` to inventory parameters.
Calculate area by multiplying height by width if physical area data is unavailable.
